With today's update, users relying on the SmartGym iPhone app will find it easier to adjust and log their workout sets during training. Details below.

SmartGym makes it easier to adjust and log workout sets while training

The SmartGym Apple Watch app has long allowed users to quickly tweak details such as reps and weight when logging each set.

With today's update, this flexibility extends to the iPhone app. Users can now choose between the original logging interface or a brand-new "inline logging" interface, letting them adjust values, log a set, and add new sets without ever leaving the same screen.

The new interface also adds a small indicator in the bottom-right corner of the reps and weight fields, showing the originally planned value for each set.

After logging a set, SmartGym also kicks off the rest timer right on the same screen, so users can keep training without having to switch views.

Here's SmartGym:

This matters because SmartGym isn't just about logging what you did, but also helping you understand what you were supposed to do.

Today's update also introduces a brand-new keyboard redesigned from the ground up, making the in-workout logging flow smoother. The keyboard includes buttons to quickly increment or decrement values, or switch between regular, warm-up, and drop sets.

As SmartGym puts it: "Every second we save in the app is a second we give back to your workout."

Finally, today's update includes a redesigned Smart Action Button that predicts the user's most likely next action, showing the appropriate action options at the bottom of the interface based on where they are in their workout.

Options include "Log Set + Start Rest," "Start Exercise," "First Supersets," "Update Set," "Next Exercise," and "End Workout," among others.

SmartGym says they've also improved the intelligence behind the Smart Action Button:

The result is a feature that feels more natural. SmartGym handles the heavy lifting behind the scenes, and users only see what they need, when they need it.

One last note: users can set the iPhone's physical Action Button to trigger SmartGym's Smart Action Button for faster workout management without even browsing through the app.

SmartGym is available as a free download on the App Store, with a variety of subscription plans.
